# Local PDF fixtures

Place private or redistribution-restricted PDFs used for manual parser testing in this directory. Git ignores the PDF files and tracks only this note.

Automated tests and CI must use synthetic or openly licensed fixtures stored outside `local/`. Do not commit copyrighted papers, private documents, credentials, or real user data.

- `zhang-2026-hierarchical-path-planning.pdf`
